title: ChamClad Classic Wall Panel
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC fire table reports FSR/SDC 15/320 for the 6-inch panel and 120/450 for the 12-inch panel under CAN/ULC-S102:2018; the S134 table says each panel meets the stated requirement.
facts.locator: CCMC 14323-R PDF, p. 9, Additional performance data / fire table

facts.text: The report says only wall assemblies meeting Intertek Listing SPEC ID 63668, Design CWL/SI 25-01, carry the cited S134 rating and lists the principal sheathing, wrap and furring conditions.

The attached June 2024 Intertek design listing specifies at least 20-gauge steel or wood studs at no more than 406 mm spacing, R-11 batts, 15.9 mm ASTM C1177 exterior gypsum, Tyvek Commercial Wrap and specified 20-gauge hat channel.
facts.locator: Intertek Spec ID 63668, Design CWL/SI 25-01, pp. 1–2

limitations: CCMC labels this fire-performance section as additional data outside its opinion.
The available Intertek design copy is dated 2024; the current directory viewer could not be retrieved.
The CCMC report says the S134 rating applies only to assemblies matching the listing.
